item.title: Debugging idempotency in Express + Firestore
item.description: An idempotency middleware for Express on Firestore looked correct on paper, then two racing requests produced a 500 on the winner, a 409 on the loser, and, worst of all, two users with the same email. Here's the full debugging trail.

item.title: You probably don't need to version your API
item.description: Versioning is a promise about how long you'll keep old code around. Most APIs make that promise too early, then break it anyway. There's a less expensive way.
